repo.description:
### Impact

A participant with chat permissions was able to delete poll drafts of other participants within the conversation based on their numeric ID.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Talk app is upgraded to 20.1.8 or 21.1.2

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References

<!-- Link to the main/master PR only -->

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3247386)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/spreed/pull/15532)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Participants were able to blindly delete poll drafts of other users by ID
